== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Karoshan]] ships are various types of spacecraft used by the [[Karoshan Empire]], ranging from massive military vessels to sleek private cruisers designed for comfort and speed rather than combat. The fleet's appearance varies significantly; some vessels are described as black, blocky, and rectangular constructions, while others appear as smooth, organic-looking ships covered in dark metal plates that glow blue-green. Some specialized craft are designed with a skeletal motif and green engines. The fleet is often piloted by mass-produced [[Nova-Bots]], though they can also be manned by [[Karoshan]] personnel. A centerpiece of their military strength is a massive, six-mile-long dreadnought that serves as a flagship and acts as a devastating engine of destruction. [[Karoshan]] naval tactics often involve screening for high-value targets, such as their queen, or fighting defensively to protect weaker vessels and allow damaged ships to retreat. Their forces have been involved in significant conflicts, including blockades of the [[Lesser Karoshan system]] and engagements against the [[Advocate]] and [[Galactic Union]] fleets. While they possess considerable firepower, their formations have occasionally been described as amateurish, leaving them vulnerable to fire from other factions.}}
